name: usage-pacing
about: Pacing before a limit, never mid-run (docs/decisions/2026-10-18-usage-awareness.md): with a 5h budget of 60k (burn: weighted tokens), one claude build (its builder set to claude: qwen would take it otherwise) takes the window to 89%. Claims slow down: #loop-digest says so, a P4 size M build goes to qwen for its run (the sandbox runner has a qwen block), and the P2 size M build, which pacing alone would hold back, still builds with claude: with no P1, size S or triage item ready, a slow pace takes the first item in the usual order while fewer than max(1, agents/3) claude runs are live (#316: pacing slows claims, never starves them). Once the window is over, claude claims are back to normal and the P2 is reviewed.
